name: pdfops-mcp
display_name: PDFops — fill, merge, inspect, invoice PDFs
description: Deterministic PDF tools for agents: inspect AcroForm fields, fill forms, merge PDFs, generate invoices.
long_description: Gives Claude local PDF tools backed by the PDFops API (https://pdfops.dev): list a PDF's form fields with a paste-ready fill template, fill AcroForm fields (optionally flattening), merge PDFs in order, and generate deterministic invoice PDFs from structured data. Inputs are file paths, https URLs or data URIs; outputs are written to a path or returned inline. Works keyless (100 requests/IP/month) or with a free API key (250/month, no card).

tools.name: pdf_inspect
tools.description: List a PDF's AcroForm fields plus a paste-ready fill template

tools.name: pdf_fill
tools.description: Fill AcroForm fields; optionally flatten; write a file or return the PDF inline

tools.name: pdf_merge
tools.description: Merge two or more PDFs in order

tools.name: pdf_invoice
tools.description: Generate a deterministic invoice PDF from structured data

tools.name: pdfops_usage
tools.description: Check the quota of the configured API key

api_key.title: PDFops API key (optional)
api_key.description: Free key from https://pdfops.dev/pricing (250 requests/month, no card). Leave empty for the keyless trial (100 requests/IP/month).
